driver_version_scope: Pascal hardware, tested with 431.36 and 512.15. Version selection is based on getter results, not a driver-version allowlist.

limitations: A single GPU was tested. Register request readback does not establish a physical voltage change.

The 431.36 driver did not expose a supported memory-clock list, so only reported P0 maximum, current memory clock, public offset and packet state were compared. Hidden or unreported ceilings remain unverified.
The V1 MSVDD field is unknown. A separate V2 MSVDD request on 512.15 returned -1 and left the saved packet unchanged.
P0 BIOS timing capture remains unavailable on both tested drivers.
